$comment: TRUTH for the authoring bundle. docs/wiki/** is a RENDER of this file (DOC-STANDARD §1 and §2: layer A is generated, never hand-edited). Render with: node scripts/wiki-authoring.mjs --root . --write. Every node must already exist on disk — this file records what IS, never what is planned; `resource` is the proof and the renderer refuses to render a node whose resource is missing.
rules: one node = one concept = one page; the id is the filename
`type` must be one of the ten in DOC-STANDARD §5.1 — the renderer rejects anything else
`resource` points at the real file this concept is about; a node whose resource does not exist is a lie and fails the render
`links` hold ids only. The renderer resolves them to relative paths, so a renamed directory never leaves a dead link behind
do not hand-edit docs/wiki/** — edit here and re-render
